items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, I was in the band when we picked him up.

ctx.x: Speaking of Billy Eckstine, were you in the band when Billy came in?

Yeah, I was in the band when we picked him up. Yeah, he wasn't even playing trumpet then, yet. He learned the trumpet on the road while we were playing theaters He would practice in the dressing room on his horn.
Well, he's known for 'Jelly, Jelly,' and was it 'Water Boy,' was another one he made?
